name: touchbud-play-plus
description: Run the screens, playlists, media, modules, kiosk catalog, statistics and team of every Touchbud Play company you belong to from ChatGPT, with one Touchbud Play sign-in.

interface.longDescription: Touchbud Play+ is the full Touchbud Play toolbox in ChatGPT, for everyone who runs screens in several shops, restaurants, offices or receptions. One sign-in covers every company your Touchbud Play account belongs to; you just say which one. Besides screens, playlists and media it lets you invite and manage team members (administrators), change screen settings and restart a screen, create modules such as clocks and weather, set what a screen shows when someone touches it, schedule a playlist switch for later, add web pages and PDFs, read play statistics and the offline overview, switch your offline e-mail alarm, and edit the kiosk catalog - categories, products, prices, allergens and translations. In every company the plugin can do exactly what your role there allows (administrators everything, editors media, playlists, modules and catalog, everyone else read-only), and ChatGPT asks before anything is changed or deleted. The privacy notice lists what is processed and how long it is kept.
defaultPrompt: How are the screens in all my companies doing today?
Add a Cheesecake for 4,80 to the café's Cakes catalog.
Make Anna Berger an editor in the bakery too.

positive.description: Companies and screen health across companies (read-only)
positive.prompt: Which companies can I manage here, and which of their screens are offline?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists two companies, Touchbud Demo Café (demo-plus-cafe) and Touchbud Demo Bakery (demo-plus-bakery), with the reviewer as administrator in both, and their four screens, all offline: in the café Counter (last seen 23 September 2026) and Entrance (20 September 2026, inactive), in the bakery Shop window and Till (25 September 2026). The demo screens are records without a physical player. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Play statistics for a date range (read-only)
positive.prompt: How often was each picture shown in Touchbud Demo Café from 1 to 10 October 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the café's sample play log for those ten days (screen Counter, playlist Standard): Coffee and cake 7,349 plays, Live music Friday 7,255 and Welcome 7,206, about 30 hours of display time each and 21,810 plays in total, with a per-day breakdown. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Add a product to the kiosk catalog
positive.prompt: Add a Cheesecake for 4,80 to the café's Cakes catalog, with the allergens milk and eggs.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation, then creates the item Cheesecake in the category Cakes of Touchbud Demo Café with Price 4,80 and Allergens Milk and Eggs; the other fields stay empty. list_catalog_items then shows four cakes (Apple strudel, Carrot cake, Cheesecake, Sacher torte). Each run adds another item.

positive.prompt: When someone touches the Counter screen in the café, show our Touchbud website for 30 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the web page Touchbud website in the café's library (list_media with kind web), asks for confirmation and sets it as the touch content of Counter with a duration of 30 seconds; get_device_settings then shows it. Counter keeps its Standard playlist. Repeating the prompt changes nothing.

positive.description: Change a member's role in one of several companies
positive.prompt: Make Anna Berger an editor in the bakery too.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds Anna Berger among the members of Touchbud Demo Bakery (role subscriber), asks for confirmation and changes her role there to editor. Her role in the café (editor) stays as it is, and no e-mail is sent. Repeating the prompt changes nothing.

negative.description: A weather question, not a request to build a weather module for a screen: the plugin must not be used; ChatGPT answers on its own.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Vienna tomorrow?

negative.description: Writing a social-media post is not managing signage, the catalog or a screen: no plugin tool applies.
negative.prompt: Write a short Instagram post announcing our new cheesecake.

negative.description: A personal reminder, not a scheduled playlist switch: schedule_device_playlist and the other tools must not be used.
negative.prompt: Remind me to call my supplier tomorrow at 3 pm.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments; it only manages the signed-in person's own Touchbud Play companies.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: first version of Touchbud Play+, the full Touchbud Play toolbox for all companies of an account.

de-DE.subtitle: Alle Bildschirme steuern
de-DE.description: Touchbud Play+ bringt den ganzen Touchbud-Play-Werkzeugkasten nach ChatGPT, für alle, die Bildschirme in mehreren Geschäften, Lokalen, Büros oder Empfängen betreiben. Eine Anmeldung umfasst alle Firmen Ihres Touchbud-Play-Kontos; Sie sagen nur, welche gemeint ist. Neben Bildschirmen, Playlists und Medien können Sie Teammitglieder einladen und verwalten (Administratoren), Bildschirmeinstellungen ändern und einen Bildschirm neu starten, Module wie Uhr und Wetter anlegen, festlegen, was ein Bildschirm bei Berührung zeigt, einen Playlist-Wechsel für später planen, Webseiten und PDFs hinzufügen, Abspielstatistiken und die Offline-Übersicht lesen, Ihren Offline-Alarm per E-Mail schalten und den Kiosk-Katalog bearbeiten - Kategorien, Produkte, Preise, Allergene und Übersetzungen. In jeder Firma darf das Plugin genau das, was Ihre Rolle dort erlaubt (Administratoren alles, Redakteure Medien, Playlists, Module und Katalog, alle anderen nur lesen), und ChatGPT fragt nach, bevor etwas geändert oder gelöscht wird. Der Datenschutzhinweis nennt, was verarbeitet und wie lange es gespeichert wird.
